integrity_note: Universal claim proved by a symbolic binary recurrence and explicit infinite family. The accompanying finite exact checker is supplementary, and an independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the absolute integer Sylvester resultant, not its sign or a finite-field common-root classification. The relevant full text of Schinzel's chapter on leading coefficients was not accessible for inspection; possible prior equivalent coverage remains an originality risk.
title: Every positive integer occurs infinitely often as a consecutive Stern-polynomial resultant
